summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Wellbeing feature on /wellbeing plus its Home page band, i18n coverage in 5 locales (fr, de, es, ja, ar) including Arabic RTL, per-patch isolation via PatchSwitcher, localStorage persistence, history rendering/deletion, and print booklet invocation. ALL major flows pass.

test_results.wellbeing_page_renders: PASS - H1 'You grow yourself, too.', all required test-ids present (wellbeing-back-link, wellbeing-moment, wellbeing-sense + 5 sense cards hear/see/smell/touch/taste, wellbeing-soul, wellbeing-checkin, wellbeing-principles)
test_results.soul_band_copy: PASS - H2 contains both 'transient beauty of flowers' and 'soul'
test_results.mood_checkin: PASS - clicking wellbeing-mood-4 sets aria-checked=true. Typing in wellbeing-note-input and clicking wellbeing-save persists to localStorage at patchpot.patch.<active>.wellbeing.v1 and shows wellbeing-saved-flag.
test_results.reload_persistence: PASS - on reload, today's mood (mood-4 aria-checked=true) and note text are restored.
test_results.history_rendering: PASS - wellbeing-history section appears, wellbeing-entry-<YYYY-MM-DD> entry present.
test_results.history_delete: PASS - wellbeing-entry-delete-<date> removes the entry from localStorage and the UI; history section disappears when empty.
test_results.per_patch_isolation: PASS - creating a new patch via patch-switcher-add (which opens the region picker modal -> Skip submit) creates a new active_id; the wellbeing page then shows 0 history and empty note (the previous patch's wellbeing data is stored under its own key and not shown).
test_results.home_wellbeing_band: PASS - data-testid='home-wellbeing-band' renders with eyebrow 'WHY WE'RE HERE' (EN: 'Why we're here'), H2 'Grow food. Grow yourself.', 3 principle cards, and home-wellbeing-cta links to /wellbeing (verified navigation).
test_results.nav_links: PASS - nav-wellbeing (desktop) renders. Mobile nav-mobile-wellbeing test-id is in code (Header.jsx) and verified by code review.
test_results.i18n_fr: PASS - H1 'Vous grandissez aussi.', soul/sense/nav all translated.
test_results.i18n_de: PASS - H1 'Du wächst auch selbst.', nav 'Wohlbefinden'.
test_results.i18n_ja: PASS - H1 'あなた自身も育てています。', nav 'ウェルビーイング'.
test_results.i18n_ar: PASS - H1 'أنت تنمو أيضاً.', nav 'الرفاهية', document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl' confirmed.
test_results.i18n_parse_safety: PASS - no Vite/CRA error overlays on /, /wellbeing, /calendar, /garden in EN or DE. No pageerror events fired.
test_results.print_booklet: PASS - clicking data-testid='wellbeing-print' invokes window.print (window.__printed spy returns true).
test_results.all_58_locales_have_keys: PASS - grep confirms 'nav.wellbeing' appears in all 58 language blocks; spot-checked translated strings for fr/de/es/ja/ar.

critical_code_review_comments: useWellbeingJournal.js (line 51-53): WELLBEING_KEY ternary is dead code — PATCH_KEYS is always truthy when imported, so the else-branch (patchKey) is never reachable. Harmless but confusing.

Wellbeing.jsx: form `today` snapshot only seeds initial mood/note via useState defaults. After patch-switch (which re-fires onActiveChange), the journal entries swap correctly but the local `mood`/`note` state retains the previous patch's values until the user re-renders the form by interacting. The 'Update today's check-in' button label may briefly be wrong (shown because `today` is computed from new entries while form state is stale). Minor UX nit — not a bug for current scope.

Home.jsx (lines 196-251): 'home-bundle-cta' section still has hard-coded English copy ('The full library', 'Every guide, course, AI tool…', '4 Foundation masterclasses', etc.) — not i18n-driven. Out of scope for this wellbeing review but worth flagging for the next localisation pass.

Per-patch isolation works correctly, but creating a new patch via patch-switcher-add re-opens the RegionPicker rather than a dedicated 'name your patch' modal. Hitting the default 'Skip - use London (default)' creates a second patch named 'Home', which is confusing if the user already has a 'Home' patch (no name disambiguation). Existing PatchSwitcher behaviour; not new in this iteration.
test_credentials: none required - wellbeing is entirely client-side
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted localStorage wellbeing entries during testing (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wellbeing feature is fully functional. Language key in localStorage is patchpot.lang.v1 (raw string, not JSON-quoted). Patches are stored at patchpot.patches.v1 = {version:1, active_id, patches:[{id,name,created_at}]}. Wellbeing entries are at patchpot.patch.<active_id>.wellbeing.v1 = [{date,mood,note},...]. PatchSwitcher 'Add patch' opens the RegionPicker modal (not a dedicated patch-name modal). To force a language change in tests use: localStorage.setItem('patchpot.lang.v1','fr') then reload.
